desc: Made to work with industry standard 1.375×24 threaded suppressors the ZR0 DTA was made to add as little length to the system as possible while being as light as possible. Made from 6Al-4V grade 5 titanium and finished with a dark gray rainbow PVD coating the ZR0 DTA comes in at 1.1 oz in 5/8×24 and 1.2 oz in 1/2×28. Made to accept a 13/16 socket to install into your suppressor with wrench flats on opposing side in the event it were to become stuck on a barrel. If inches and ounces matter to you and you’re a fan of direct thread mounting then you will find no better mount than the ZR0 DTA.
